# Avenly Bakehouse

> Avenly Bakehouse (अवनली बेकहाउस) is an artisan bakery and café in Dehradun, serving handcrafted cakes, pastries, cheesecakes, specialty coffee and a full kitchen menu since 2021. Rated 4.7 stars from 368 Google reviews; 4.4 on Zomato from 1,822 ratings.

## Menu & Ordering

- [Full menu on Zomato](https://www.zomato.com/dehradun/avenly-bakehouse-miyanwala/order): Cakes, bento cakes, cheesecakes, pastries, burgers, pasta, drinks and quick bites
- [Order on Swiggy](https://www.swiggy.com/city/dehradun/avenly-bakehouse-doiwala-doiwala-rest1024350): Delivery across Dehradun
- [Zomato listing](https://www.zomato.com/dehradun/avenly-bakehouse-miyanwala): Menu, photos and reviews

## Visit

- [Location on Google Maps](https://maps.google.com/?q=Avenly+Bakehouse+Dehradun): Jollygrant Chowk, Rishikesh Road, Dehradun, Uttarakhand 248016
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/avenlybakehouse): @avenlybakehouse
- [Official website](https://avenly.in): avenly.in
